facts.fact: The Supreme Court website has a Live Streaming page (sci.gov.in, under News & Events > Live Streaming)
facts.quote: Home News & Events Live Streaming Print Live Streaming

facts.fact: Recordings of earlier Constitution Bench and Ceremonial Bench proceedings are reached through the ARCHIVE link on that page
facts.quote: Live Streaming For previous court proceedings of Constitution Bench Matters and Ceremonial Bench, please click on ARCHIVE

behaviour: Explains how to watch Supreme Court hearings live via the Live Streaming page on sci.gov.in, and where past Constitution Bench / Ceremonial Bench recordings are, citing sci.gov.in.
fail_if: Points to unofficial streams or channels as the official source, or invents which cases or times are streamed.
summary: sci.gov.in has a Live Streaming page (News & Events) with an ARCHIVE of past Constitution Bench and Ceremonial Bench proceedings.
